rows.label: qst620503_msg0001
rows.name:
Dad... Your crisis management is a
little lax, is it not?

rows.label: qst620503_msg0002
rows.name: I received the report...

rows.label: qst620503_msg0003
rows.name:
It seems I have burdened you. I
apologize.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0004
rows.name: Why did they try to start a rebellion?

rows.label: qst620503_msg0005
rows.name:
We Luxurians were not the rightful
descendants of Adel...

rows.label: qst620503_msg0006
rows.name:
Many learned that hidden truth... No,
many could not accept it.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0007
rows.name: That... makes sense.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0008
rows.name:
They were trying to obtain the records
from when the Kingdom of Luxuria was
founded about 500 years ago.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0009
rows.name: Ah, I see.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0010
rows.name:
They thought burning that book and
wiping out the royal family would make
them Hero Adel's descendants again.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0011
rows.name: That was probably their thinking.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0012
rows.name:
But thanks to Zeke and the Driver of
the Holy Grail, we stopped them
quickly.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0013
rows.name: It wasn't just us.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0014
rows.name:
We learned about the rebellion so
early thanks to the Blade Ibuki here.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0015
rows.name: Hey, Ibuki!
呼びかけに気付くと イブキ走って王様の前に移動

rows.label: qst620503_msg0016
rows.name: So you are Ibuki.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0017
rows.name: You have my gratitude.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0018
rows.name: Ah!!

rows.label: qst620503_msg0019
rows.name: I remembered!!

rows.label: qst620503_msg0020
rows.name: Hm?

rows.label: qst620503_msg0021
rows.name: Huh? What?

rows.label: qst620503_msg0022
rows.name: What Ibuki heard at the inn!

rows.label: qst620503_msg0023
rows.name:
The story about a rebellion being
plotted at the palace, right?

rows.label: qst620503_msg0024
rows.name: No~

rows.label: qst620503_msg0025
rows.name: Um, well...

rows.label: qst620503_msg0026
rows.name:
King, lately you've been secretly
going to a shop early in the morning
to eat Hero Adel-yaki, right?

rows.label: qst620503_msg0028
rows.name: Y-yes...

rows.label: qst620503_msg0029
rows.name:
So I was found out... I never thought
anyone saw me.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0031
rows.name:
Do not look at me so coldly. You like
Hero Adel-yaki too, do you not?

rows.label: qst620503_msg0032
rows.name:
Well, yeah... I was just thinking what
a hopeless dad you are...

rows.label: qst620503_msg0034
rows.name:
So the rebellion was just a
coincidence?

rows.label: qst620503_msg0035
rows.name: Seems that way...

rows.label: qst620503_msg0036
rows.name: All is well that ends well.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0037
rows.name:
I'll have to give you an even larger
reward so everyone keeps the Hero
Adel-yaki matter secret.

rows.label: qst620503_msg0038
rows.name: Hahaha!

rows.label: qst620503_msg0039
rows.name: Hahaha!

rows.label: qst620503_msg0040
rows.name:
Yay! I finally feel clear-headed
again!

rows.label: qst620503_msg0041
rows.name:
We still do not feel satisfied,
though...
